title: Advance Anti Item Blast
description: A premium Minecraft plugin that protects specific dropped items from all explosion types, with GUI management, permissions, PlaceholderAPI, and bStats support.
body:
# 🛡️ AdvanceItemAntiBlast
### **Elite Explosion Protection for your Server Drops**

Stop losing your valuable loot to accidental TNT blasts, Creeper surprises, or Wither fights. **AdvanceItemAntiBlast** allows server administrators to whitelist specific items that will be 100% immune to all forms of explosion damage.

---

## ✨ Features
* **🔥 Absolute Protection:** Protected items survive TNT, Creepers, End Crystals, Respawn Anchors, Beds (in Nether/End), Ghast Fireballs, and Withers.
* **🎮 Interactive GUI:** Manage your protected items list through a beautiful, paginated in-game menu (`/aib gui`).
* **⚙️ Live Management:** Add or remove items instantly without restarting the server.
* **📊 Smart Stats:** Track exactly how many items have been saved from destruction.
* **🌍 World Support:** Enable protection only in specific worlds.
* **💾 Auto-Backups:** Automatically creates a backup of your configuration every time you reload.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/aib add <item>` | Add item to protection list | `advanceitemantiblast.admin` |
| `/aib remove <item>` | Remove an item from protection | `advanceitemantiblast.admin` |
| `/aib gui` | Open the interactive management menu | `advanceitemantiblast.gui` |
| `/aib list` | View all protected items in chat | `advanceitemantiblast.admin` |
| `/aib stats` | View plugin uptime and items saved | `advanceitemantiblast.stats` |
| `/aib reload` | Reload config and messages | `advanceitemantiblast.reload` |

---

## 🚀 Placeholders (PlaceholderAPI)
* `%anti_blast_protected_count%` - Total number of protected item types.
* `%anti_blast_prevented_total%` - Total individual items saved.
* `%anti_blast_uptime%` - Plugin uptime.

---

## 📦 Compatibility
* **Version:** Minecraft 1.21+
* **Platform:** Paper, Purpur, Spigot
* **Java:** 21

---

*Developed by **Diolezz**. Optimized for high-performance servers.*
